name: qw2gn5-compact-needs-you-chat
goal: Prove Hub Home shows compact choices with details and typing in dialogs, opens Chief of Staff chat in a bottom-right desktop overlay or a full-screen phone sheet, and documents the list-card rule.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Updated existing Needs You and Hub message specs with compact chips, detail and confirmation dialogs, desktop CoS widget and phone sheet. Mac and iPhone Tracker inbox uses distinct components.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Compact buttons reuse structured answer controls. Confirmation and Other dialogs render beside the list. All Hub Chief of Staff launch points share one Modal and composer. Desktop and iPhone use their separate TrackerInbox renderer.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: harbor-mbp-2: the strengthened 19-case browser baseline on 4e6b47cf84 had 9 expected failures (inline composer, list descriptions, and inline confirmation); 65/65 Hub E2Es passed on 10670485a2. Four focused Hub unit and integration files passed 12 tests, plus the shared design guidance test.
